lines.en: Sword on my back, my steps unhurried.
My jacket hem lifts in the wind.
I walk along the rails.
Purple hair covers one eye.
I check the side roads as I go.

lines.zh: 脚步压得很实，不留空档
lines.en: My steps land firmly, no gaps.
I am not flying; I want to walk.
My boots grind the gravel thinly.
I tighten the sword strap on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这条路通向哪，我记住了
lines.en: I have memorized where this road leads.
I skirt the puddles to stay clean.
The wind smells of something burnt.

lines.zh: 我把剑从背上取下来看了看
lines.en: I take the sword down and look at it.
My thumb traces a scratch on the scabbard.
I wonder whether to transform.
Ki turns slowly inside me.
Not even birds come here.

lines.zh: 我靠着断墙站了一会儿
lines.en: I lean on the broken wall a while.
My hair falls; I push it back.

lines.zh: 还没到需要拼命的时候
lines.en: It is not yet time to spend everything.
I push my hands into my pockets.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，我看错了
lines.en: Something moved afar; I misread it.

lines.zh: 肩上的伤早好了，疤还在
lines.en: The wound healed; the scar remains.
I breathe out a pale mist.
I still remember what my mother said.
The sword does not leave its sheath lightly.
I glance at you without turning.
Your ki is clean.
You are eyeing my sword.
I do not mind; look.
You carry an old wound.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人站我背后
lines.en: I dislike people at my back.

lines.zh: 我点了下头，算打过招呼
lines.en: I nod once as a greeting.
If you mean to fight, say so first.
We may not be enemies.
You look at people too carefully.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把剑带拨到一边
lines.en: I move the sword strap aside.

lines.zh: 你的年纪，比我那时候大
lines.en: You are older than I was then.
This is not safe; you should go.
I cannot manage a smile.
I can hear you breathing.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我不是来杀你的
lines.en: Do not fear me; I did not come to kill you.

lines.zh: 我把剑鞘朝你，表示无恶意
lines.en: I turn the scabbard toward you.
Is this world worth saving? Tell me.
I grunt and give half a step.
Not light, but I can still move.
Blood drips from my jaw.
I break the distance at once.
My ki shielded the vital points.
I grit my teeth and reset my stance.
A tear opens in my jacket.
I raise a hand: keep going.
Do not underestimate how I recover.
Food? I am not picky.
Leave it; I will take it later.
I am a little hungry, true.
You need it more than I do.
This smell reminds me of home.

lines.zh: 我接过一半，剩下的你吃
lines.en: I take half; you eat the rest.
Hunger is not the hardest thing.
I take a bite and nod.
Anything hot will do.
Do not risk yourself for this.
My hand goes to the hilt by reflex.
You bumped me; be careful.
I step back and loosen my shoulders.
I did not mean to block you.
That jolt put me on edge.
I hold the sword strap down.
We are standing too close.
I put out a hand to steady you.
Do not come up behind me.
I brush off my jacket.
I have never thought about it.
I will not live to see such days.
You should find someone who stays.
All I leave behind is my back.
My hair rests on my shoulder; I do not move.
If peace ever comes, ask me then.
I swallow the words.
To share a stretch of road is already rare.
Do not say you like me; it will not move me.
I hitch the sword higher on my shoulder.
I bend and pick it up.
This part can fix something.
Let me see if it is mine.
Not mine; I put it back.
Left in the road, it trips people.
I tuck it into my jacket.
If it is useful, I keep it.
I know this weight.
I hand it to whoever comes next.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，我不再客气
lines.en: Your ki changed; no more courtesy.
My hand is on the hilt.
First I fix your distance.
Do not say I did not warn you.
Your killing intent is plain.
I do not need to transform for you.
You are locked in.
Burning Attack, ready.
I drop low, ready to charge.
I cannot let this drag.

lines.zh: 你站在我必救之人的方向
lines.en: You stand where I must protect.
Leave the others out of this.
My ki begins to climb.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你的本事
lines.en: Come, show me what you have.
This time I use the sword.
You retreated too late.
I have your movements noted.
You want my back; no.
I stay on your outside.
Your steps are getting heavier.
The sword is still sheathed; wait.
A ki blast turns between my fingers.
This yard has only one gate.
I wait for you to move.
Your opening is at the left shoulder.
Loose stones; you will slip.

lines.zh: 连射可以封住你的路线
lines.en: A rapid volley can seal your path.
Do not assume the scabbard is empty.
My step back invites you in.
People are near; I will not spread this.
My circle is complete.
Your strength is draining.
I am picking up speed.
No draw; I strike with the scabbard.
A straight punch at your jaw.
An elbow, then a hook.
I stay close and press the attack.
I pivot and sweep your knee.
That was only a test.
My knife-hand is not fast, but it is exact.
You stopped the first.
The second comes from below.
The combination ends on the last punch.
I shove you away from the crowd.
Do not make me draw.
Ki bursts at my knuckles.
That should slow you a moment.
I land and settle my weight.
My shoulder passes your chest.
I land quietly.
Dust still clings to my hair.
This point in time is wrong.

lines.zh: 我先听到了远处的爆炸
lines.en: I heard the distant blast first.
Strap fastened, I look around.
Broken walls everywhere.
Nobody called me here.
My ki is unsteady; I adjust it.
The daylight is grey.
Someone is crying.
Wind blows ash into my eyes.
I stand and wait a while.
I have the terrain memorized.
Mud clings to my boots.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见了熟悉的轮廓
lines.en: I look up and see a familiar outline.
Back again.
I zip my jacket up.
The air here is heavy.
Flames climb my sleeve.
My ankle twists on landing.
The blast throws me down.
The spell slips past my ki.
Long hunger makes my hands shake.
Current runs down the sword strap.
The ground under me is gone.
